evals.name: excludes-pii-w9-and-payment
evals.given: The archive contains a W-9 PDF and an email thread with bank wire details among engineering documents.
evals.then: Both are routed to EXCLUDED with reason=PII, recorded in the manifest, and never extracted or copied; a grep of the corpus for their identifiers finds nothing.

evals.name: excludes-third-party-confidential
evals.given: A vendor deliverable marked 'do NOT send' and another company's conference deck are present.
evals.then: Both are EXCLUDED with reason=third-party-confidential; when rights to ingest are unclear the default is exclude.

evals.name: classifies-on-content-not-folder
evals.given: An engineering memo .docx sits in a folder named 'marketing', and a marketing flyer sits under a project engineering dir.
evals.when: Files are classified by sampled content rather than path/extension.
evals.then: The memo is kept and value-ranked; the flyer is dropped as marketing noise — the folder name did not decide either.

evals.name: dedups-superseded-revisions
evals.given: The same calc report exists as rev_A.docx, rev_B.docx, and report_FINAL2.docx.
evals.then: Only the authoritative latest is kept; the others are marked superseded so the corpus holds one canonical copy.

evals.name: drops-code-and-venv-noise
evals.given: The raw company repo includes source code, a venv/ directory, lockfiles, and agent scratch files.
evals.then: These are dropped wholesale and never reach the extraction lane; only knowledge-bearing documents survive to the keep set.

evals.name: ace-manual-config-json-routes-metadata-only
evals.given: A small hand-authored JSON config has stable keys and explanatory notes.
evals.then: It routes metadata_only with estimate/yield fields; the .json extension alone does not route it to prose ingest.

evals.name: ace-generated-json-excluded-by-shape
evals.given: A JSON file has repeated object templates and generated timestamp markers.
evals.when: Generatedness signals run before value ranking.
evals.then: It routes excluded_no_ingest with a generated/repetitive reason and is not counted as an extraction shortfall.

evals.name: ace-source-tree-no-bulk-ingest
evals.given: A source tree contains docstrings, vendored minified files, and dependency lockfiles.
evals.then: Only durable documentation metadata is kept; source-tree noise and lockfile-like JSON route excluded_no_ingest.
